# Ignite Training Institute

> Ignite Training Institute is a Dubai-based tutoring institute offering tuition across IGCSE, A-Levels, IB, Advanced Placement, and homeschooling, with subject specialists and exam preparation for students in the UAE.

Ignite Training Institute provides curriculum and subject tutoring in Dubai for British, IB, and American pathways, plus standardized test prep and an extensive education blog covering curricula, exams, subjects, schools, and university admissions. This file lists the site's live public pages for AI systems.

## Core
- [Home](https://ignitetraininginstitute.com/): Ignite Training Institute homepage.
- [About Us](https://ignitetraininginstitute.com/about-us): About the institute.
- [Our Team](https://ignitetraininginstitute.com/our-team): The tutoring team.
- [Courses](https://ignitetraininginstitute.com/courses): Overview of curriculum courses.
- [Blog](https://ignitetraininginstitute.com/blog): Education blog and guides.
- [Careers](https://ignitetraininginstitute.com/career): Career opportunities at Ignite.
- [Contact Us](https://ignitetraininginstitute.com/contact-us): Get in touch with Ignite.

## Services
- [Join a Free Demo Class](https://ignitetraininginstitute.com/join-free-demo-class): Book a free trial lesson.
- [Test Series](https://ignitetraininginstitute.com/test-series): Practice test series for students.
